source_size_review.heading_order: Visual source-size check found expected front/front-quarter/profile/back-quarter/back order.
source_size_review.identity: Blue spiky fin crest, expressive amber eyes, curled blue tail, navy armor/tunic and gold edging retained.
source_size_review.proportions: Head/crest visually near one-third standing-equivalent height; no gross large-head redesign. Exact runtime-native skull/volume continuity unverified.
source_size_review.pose_readability: Anticipation and deeper landing visibly differentiated; rise has tucked/pointed feet and wider balancing arms, fall lowers arms and places feet beneath body.
source_size_review.cropped_extremities: No cell-edge clipping found visually or at alpha>=128 bounds.
natural_occlusions: Direct front tail can be hidden behind torso/pelvis.
Far-side hand, foot and tail root may overlap torso, near limbs or tail in profile and rear-quarter views.
